links.outcome: ICD coding accuracy of LLMs with versus without retrieval augmentation from standardized classifications
links.effect: RAG improved base LLM performance; Llama 3.3 70B with RAG reached 80.6% partial-match (ICD-10) and 75.0% (ICD-O), beating embedding approaches on partial match but not on exact match.
links.quote: RAG improved base LLM performance and outperformed embedding-based approaches on partial-match accuracy (80.6% partial-match accuracy for ICD-10 and 75.0% for ICD-O with Llama 3.3 70B), but not on exact-match accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Comparing embedding-based similarity search and classification against LLM-based RAG for ICD coding

screen.practice: retrieval grounding (RAG) added to LLM for ICD coding
screen.reason: Evaluates the impact of adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to LLMs compared to standalone LLMs and embedding models for clinical ICD coding of tumor diagnoses.
